content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Conversions ## slug: google-analytics-conversions ## seoTitle: Conversions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Use Google Tag Manager and conversions to track specific user actions such as purchasing a Ticket for an Event. Per [Google](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9267568?hl=en#){target=`_blank`}, > The primary way to measure a Google Analytics conversion is to create or identify an event that measures the important user interaction and then [mark the event as a conversion](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/13128484){target=`_blank`}. For example, if you use the Google tag or Tag Manager, you would create the event for your website and then go to Google Analytics to mark the event as a conversion. Use the instructions [here](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/12966437){target=`_blank`} to set up a conversion in Google Analytics 4.
